# Jubilees Chapter 25 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Jacob Refuses Canaanite Wives; Rebecca's Instructions; Jacob's Blessing

---

**25:1** In the second year of this week, Rebecca called her son Jacob and said to him: "My son, do not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan, as your brother Esau has done — he has taken two wives from the daughters of Canaan, and they have embittered my spirit on account of all their unclean deeds. All their ways are fornication and lust, and there is no righteousness in them, for their ways are evil.

**25:2** But I, my son, love you exceedingly, and my heart and my affections rejoice in you. I want to keep you from taking one of the daughters of Canaan.

**25:3** Go to the house of your grandfather Bethuel and take a wife for yourself from there — from the daughters of your mother's brother Laban. Take a wife from there who is good and upright.

**25:4** I know that she will be good for you, and you will be a blessing on the earth and a blessing for all your descendants on the earth.

**25:5** I will count none of the days I live as days of joy unless I see your children — unless I know that before I leave your presence you have gone and taken a wife from that place.

**25:6** Go, my son. Your uncle Laban will embrace you and rejoice over you. Take a wife from among his daughters. I know that the LORD will bless you above all my children, because you are the firstborn and the holy one.

**25:7** I will go and pray and petition the LORD your God that he may guide you in the right way, so that you may find a good wife, and that the LORD may bless all your descendants with righteousness throughout all the generations of the earth."

**25:8** Jacob said to his mother Rebecca: "I will not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan, and I will not take an evil wife — for all your commandments and the commandments of my father Abraham are exceedingly dear to me, and my father Isaac has also commanded me not to take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.

**25:9** Do not be troubled on my account, mother, for I will walk in righteousness."

**25:10** Rebecca arose and embraced her son Jacob and kissed him, and she loved him exceedingly — more than all her children.

**25:11** She said to him: "Be blessed, my son, by the LORD of all — the God who created heaven and earth — and I pray that he will bless you above all generations of mankind. May he give you righteousness and holiness, my son, and sanctify you. May he plant you in the earth, establish you, and raise you up.

**25:12** And I will go and bless the LORD your God and petition him concerning you. May you walk in the right way and be blessed with the blessings of heaven and of earth, of light and of the deep.

**25:13** May your seed inherit the earth and fill it from east to west and from north to south, and may all the angels of the presence bless you and go before you.

**25:14** Stand firm, my son, and fear no one. Do not be disheartened, but reign over all the seed of Seth.

**25:15** For you and your seed alone are chosen to rule over all the earth. Among all nations and peoples, you shall be great in the name of the LORD. They shall call you servants of the Most High, and you shall be sons and heirs of the living God of heaven.

**25:16** Every spirit of truth is with you, and every angel of light is with you, and they rejoice in the LORD. You shall rule over his sanctuary, and there shall be no impurity in your sanctuary.

**25:17** Now, my son, may the LORD God be with you. May I see and hear good news of your children before I go to my fathers."

**25:18** Jacob said to his mother Rebecca: "I am indeed blessed and glorious, and I will walk in all the commandments of the LORD, and there will be righteousness in my ways. I will not forsake you, my mother, but will seek the LORD all my days.

**25:19** And I bless you — blessed are you and all the works of your hands, my mother, for you have remembered me. I thank you greatly for your blessing."

**25:20** After this, Rebecca called her son Esau and said to him: "My son, I beg you — do not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan."

**25:21** Esau answered his mother: "I will not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan either; I will take a wife from among the daughters of my grandfather Ishmael." And Rebecca was comforted.

**25:22** Isaac called Jacob and blessed him and commanded him, saying: "You shall not take a wife from any of the daughters of Canaan. Arise and go to Mesopotamia, to the house of Bethuel your mother's father, and take a wife from among the daughters of Laban your mother's brother.

**25:23** And may God Almighty bless you and multiply you and make you into a great multitude. May he make you into a company of nations, and may he give you the blessing of my father Abraham — to you and to your seed after you — that you may inherit the land of your sojournings and all the land which God gave to Abraham."

---
*LOGOS notes: Rebecca's expanded blessing (vv.11-16) is unique to Jubilees and draws on the angelology of the book throughout (angels of the presence, angels of light, spirits of truth). "Seed of Seth" (v.14) = all humanity. The chapter concludes with Isaac's parallel command (vv.22-23), which echoes Gen 28:1-4.*
